title: 第3章  父亲的补偿
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
奇花不谢，翠柏长春，玉阳峰上灵气充沛至极，放眼看去，到处都是珍稀的奇花异草，千年万年的灵药，如同杂草似的长在路边。
谢莲心一落地，脑海中传来了谢逸的声音：
“来莲月池。”
谢莲心转身朝着莲月池方向飞去。
————
莲池水光如镜，静得不似人间。
莲池旁边的水阁中，白衣胜雪的男人坐在玉几旁边，他手中端着一杯仙茗，蓝色眼瞳看着水池。池中朵朵白莲从碧色莲叶中探出头来，花瓣上沾着灵露。
远处，两只仙鹤自水雾深处踱来，长喙偶尔没入水中，漾开圈圈极淡的涟漪。忽地，一道红色流光落在此处，变成了一个白衣的少女。
谢莲心一眼看到了自己的父亲，父亲旁边站着两个美貌侍女。
那两个侍女一身白纱衣，蒙着面纱，露出无神的眼瞳。玉阳峰上，只有三个活人，其余的人形生物都是炼金傀儡。
“师尊。”谢莲心喊了一声。
“坐。”
谢逸道。
谢莲心在谢逸对面的蒲团坐下，谢逸俊美的面容上神情不显，只是将手中的茶放下。他衣袖一拂，这玉几上就多了一个大大的蛋。这蛋上有着红色的花纹，透出了惊人的火属性灵气，谢莲心还感受到了其中的蕴藏的一丝神性。
“这是……”
谢莲心惊讶地看着自己父亲。
“这是火灵雀的蛋，这个蛋蕴含凤凰血脉，比你之前那个青玄鹰的蛋强上百倍。我知道你的那个灵兽蛋，是你好不容易寻来的，但你师妹也不是故意的。这火灵雀的蛋，算是补偿你。”谢逸道。
谢莲心抱起了那大大的蛋，抚摸着上面的花纹，这花纹跟小红的蛋一模一样啊。她满脸的震惊。前世她捡到了一个稀有的青玄鹰的蛋，喜欢得不得了，她将那蛋抱出去晒个太阳，就被柳如烟“不小心”砸碎了。
她很生气，隔日重伤了柳如烟，接着因为当众顶撞谢逸，被他罚面壁思过十年。她满心委屈，她觉得师尊偏心，什么都想着柳如烟。她没有老老实实地在后山面壁，跑出去了。
然后她又捡到了一个蛋，那蛋还是忽然从天上掉下来了的，落在她脚步。一个火灵雀的蛋，比青玄鹰的蛋更稀有，还是具有凤凰血统的。

那个蛋最后被她孵化出来了，她给那只火灵雀取名叫“小红”。
现在她才明白，哪有什么凤凰血统的灵兽蛋从天上掉下刚好落在脚边，分明就是有人故意扔给她的。
谢莲心抱着那大大的蛋，望着自己的父亲，眼中有些许晶莹。
她甚至能想象到上辈子，他藏在暗处，偷偷看着她抱着从天而降的灵兽蛋欣喜若狂的样子来。
谢逸见她一副激动得仿佛要哭出来的样子，心中不解，不过，她喜欢就好了。他道：
“你好好孵化它吧，日后应该能对你提供不小的帮助。你师妹她……她年幼丧母，现在父亲也没了，也没其他亲人，孤苦伶仃，你是师姐，就多让让她吧。”
谢莲心本来很激动的，但是这话她不爱听，差点条件反射开怼，又硬生生地咽下去，只是语气轻轻地说了句：“至少她见过自己的父母。”
谢逸心中一颤。
面前的少女望着他，她说：“我从来没见过我爹娘，我都不知道他们长什么样子。”
少女的紫色的眼睛清澈无垢，却让谢逸心中刺痛。
她明明有父母，但是她的父母不认她。她的母亲不要她，她的父亲不认她。
他让她叫他师尊，在她心里，她就是无父无母的孤儿。
他还要她让着柳如烟，比她还大四岁的柳如烟。
谢逸忽然发觉自己有多不可理喻，他的心脏在瞬间好像被无形的手撕扯了一样，痛得厉害。
他只觉得柳如烟可怜，可怜她父母双亡，无依无靠，却没想过在自己女儿的心里，她连自己父母都没见过。
他凭什么让她让着柳如烟？
“你爹娘……”
谢逸想要为自己辩解几句，开口却一句话都说不出来。
父女两个久久无言。
谢莲心看出了谢逸心虚和内疚，她心里也委屈。虽然她已经不像前世那么怨恨他了，但她心里还是有怨念的。

她不想喊他师尊。
“我去孵化这蛋了。”
谢莲心抱着火灵雀的蛋站起来，谢逸看着她一步步地走远之后，长长地叹息了一声。如果有一天，她知道了自己是她父亲，她会有什么反应？
她一定会恨极了自己吧。
他心想。
————
谢莲心抱着大大的蛋走在瑶草喷香的小径，她走着走着就遇到了柳如烟。柳如烟是刚刚回来的，她跟谢莲心一碰上，就注意到了谢莲心手中那个大大的蛋。
“师姐，这是……？”柳如烟的目光落在那蛋上，就算她修为低微，都能感受到那蛋的不凡。
“这个啊，火灵雀的蛋，师尊给我的。这火灵雀的蛋可硬了，这回师妹就是再不小心也摔不碎了。呵呵~”谢莲心笑着说。
柳如烟脸色难看，以前的谢莲心都是冷着一张脸的，现在这样阴阳怪气地说话，她很不习惯。
“师姐，我、我真的不是故意的。我……”
柳如烟说着那眼眶儿又要红了。
谢莲心笑着说：
“没关系，我都大方原谅你了。要不是你不小心摔了，师尊也不会特地找一个火灵雀的蛋给我孵化，这个蛋还有凤凰血统呢，说不定日后真有机会进化成凤凰，凤凰做灵兽，多有面子啊！”
谢莲心每说一句，柳如烟的脸色就难看一分，等到谢莲心蹦蹦跳跳地哼着歌走远了，柳如烟近乎咬牙切齿了。
师尊居然给她这么珍贵的灵兽蛋做补偿，师尊偏心！
他怎么能这么偏心呢！！
柳如烟妒忌，妒忌得要命。
谢莲心回到自己的住处，立刻拿出了一个大大的篮子，将火灵雀的蛋放在了篮子里。她在篮子里放置了许多的火灵晶石，然后将这篮子收入了储物袋子里，随身携带，不给柳如烟任何的机会碰她的蛋。
蒙着面纱的侍女走上前来给谢莲心端上了灵茶，谢莲心盯着屋子里的傀儡侍女出神。

整个仙盟都大量使用炼金傀儡干粗活，但是一般的炼金傀儡只有筑基金丹修为，金丹以上就算是高级傀儡了，目前的炼金傀儡顶多是炼虚水平。
前世谢莲心成功地炼制过大乘期的傀儡，她在想，如果她设计一套灵力回路，在里面做点手脚，再推广出去，让全仙盟的人使用她创造的傀儡，这不就能在整个仙盟都埋下自己的眼线了吗？
她可以随心所欲地监视任何人。
想想有点兴奋，谢莲心兴奋地拿出了绘灵笔出来，在白纸上打起了草稿。
content_en:
Strange flowers never fade, green cypresses are evergreen, and the spiritual energy on Yuyang Peak is extremely abundant. Looking around, there are rare flowers and rare herbs everywhere, and elixirs that have been used for thousands of years grow on the roadside like weeds.
As soon as Xie Lian's heart fell to the ground, Xie Yi's voice came in her mind:
"Come to Lotus Moon Pond."
Xie Lianxin turned around and flew towards the direction of Lotus Moon Pond.
————
The water in the lotus pond is as bright as a mirror, and it is as quiet as the human world.
In the water pavilion next to the lotus pond, a man in white clothes was sitting next to the jade table. He was holding a cup of fairy tea in his hand and looking at the pond with blue eyes. White lotuses peek out from the green lotus leaves in the pond, and their petals are stained with spiritual dew.
In the distance, two cranes came from the depths of the mist, their long beaks occasionally submerged in the water, causing very faint ripples. Suddenly, a red stream of light fell here and turned into a girl in white.
Xie Lianxin saw her father at a glance. There were two beautiful maids standing next to her father.
The two maids were dressed in white gauze and veiled, revealing their dull eyes. There are only three living people on Yuyang Peak, and the rest of the humanoid creatures are alchemy puppets.
"Master." Xie Lianxin shouted.
"Sit."
Xie Yi said.
Xie Lianxin sat down on the futon opposite Xie Yi. Xie Yi's handsome face showed no expression and he just put down the tea in his hand. With a flick of his sleeve, a big egg appeared on the jade table. There were red patterns on the egg, which revealed an astonishing fire-attribute aura. Xie Lianxin also felt a trace of divinity contained in it.
"This is..."
Xie Lianxin looked at her father in surprise.
"This is the egg of the Fire Spirit Bird. This egg contains the blood of the phoenix and is hundreds of times stronger than the egg of the Blue Black Eagle you had before. I know that you found that spirit beast egg with great difficulty, but your junior sister didn't do it on purpose. This egg of the Fire Spirit Bird is compensation for you," Xie Yi said.
Xie Lianxin picked up the big egg and stroked the pattern on it. The pattern was exactly the same as Xiaohong's egg. Her face was full of shock. In her previous life, she picked up a rare Green Black Eagle egg and liked it very much. She took the egg out to bask in the sun, but Liu Ruyan "accidentally" smashed it.
She was very angry and severely injured Liu Ruyan the next day. Then because she contradicted Xie Yi in public, he punished her by facing the wall and thinking about it for ten years. She was full of grievances. She felt that her master was partial and thought of Liu Ruyan. Instead of facing the wall at the back of the mountain, she ran out.
Then she picked up another egg, which suddenly fell from the sky and landed in her footsteps. A fire sparrow egg is rarer than a blue black eagle egg, and it still has the blood of the phoenix.
The egg was finally hatched by her, and she named the fire sparrow "Little Red".
Only now did she understand that any phoenix-blooded spirit beast egg fell from the sky and landed at her feet. Someone had clearly thrown it to her on purpose.
Xie Lianxin held the big egg and looked at her father with a little sparkle in her eyes.
She could even imagine that in her previous life, he was hiding in the dark and secretly watching her ecstatically holding the spirit beast egg that fell from the sky.
Seeing her looking so excited that she seemed about to cry, Xie Yi felt puzzled, but as long as she liked it, that was fine. He said:
"You should hatch it well. It should be of great help to you in the future. Your junior sister...she lost her mother when she was young. Now her father is gone and she has no other relatives. She is all alone. You are a senior sister, so give her more."
Xie Lianxin was originally very excited, but she didn't like hearing these words. She almost started to yell out of reflex, and swallowed it hard. She just said softly: "At least she has met her parents."
Xie Yi's heart trembled.
The girl in front of him looked at him and said, "I have never seen my parents. I don't even know what they look like."
The girl's purple eyes were clear and innocent, but they made Xie Yi's heart sting.
She obviously has parents, but her parents don't recognize her. Her mother doesn't want her,Her father disowned her.
He asked her to call him Master. In her heart, she was an orphan without a father or a mother.
He also wanted her to give way to Liu Ruyan, who was four years older than her.
Xie Yi suddenly realized how unreasonable he was. His heart felt as if it had been torn apart by invisible hands in an instant, and the pain was severe.
He only felt pitiful for Liu Ruyan, pitiful that her parents were dead and she was helpless, but he never thought that in his daughter's heart, she had never even met her own parents.
Why should he let her give in to Liu Ruyan?
"Your parents..."
Xie Yi wanted to defend himself, but couldn't say a word.
Father and daughter were silent for a long time.
Xie Lianxin saw Xie Yi's guilt and guilt, and she felt aggrieved. Although she no longer resented him as much as she did in her previous life, she still felt resentment in her heart.
She didn't want to call him Master.
"I'm going to hatch this egg."
Xie Lianxin stood up holding the Fire Spirit Bird's egg. Xie Yi watched her walk away step by step and sighed longly. If one day, she knew that he was her father, how would she react?
She must hate herself very much.
he thought.
————
Xie Lianxin held the big egg and walked on the path fragrant with Yao grass. As she walked, she met Liu Ruyan. Liu Ruyan had just returned. As soon as she met Xie Lianxin, she noticed the big egg in Xie Lianxin's hand.
"Senior sister, is this...?" Liu Ruyan's eyes fell on the egg. Even if she had a low cultivation level, she could feel the extraordinary quality of the egg.
"This, the fire sparrow's egg, my master gave it to me. The fire sparrow's egg is so hard, junior sister can't break it even if she's not careful this time. Haha~" Xie Lianxin said with a smile.
Liu Ruyan's face was ugly. Xie Lianxin used to have a cold face, but now she was not used to talking so sinisterly.
"Senior sister, I, I really didn't mean it. I..."
As Liu Ruyan spoke, her eyes turned red again.
Xie Lianxin smiled and said:
"It doesn't matter, I forgive you generously. If you hadn't accidentally dropped it, Master wouldn't have found a fire sparrow egg to hatch for me. This egg also has the blood of a phoenix. Maybe there will be a chance to evolve into a phoenix in the future. A phoenix is a spiritual beast, so it's so honorable!"
Every time Xie Lianxin said something, Liu Ruyan's face became uglier. When Xie Lianxin walked away humming a song in a bouncing voice, Liu Ruyan was almost gritting his teeth.
Master actually gave her such a precious spirit beast egg as compensation, Master is partial!
How could he be so partial! !
Liu Ruyan was jealous, extremely jealous.
Xie Lianxin returned to her residence, immediately took out a large basket and placed the Fire Sparrow's eggs in the basket. She placed a lot of fire crystals in the basket, then put the basket into a storage bag and carried it with her, not giving Liu Ruyan any chance to touch her eggs.
The veiled maid came forward and served Xie Lianxin some spiritual tea. Xie Lianxin stared at the puppet maid in the room in trance.
The entire Immortal League uses a large number of alchemy puppets to do rough work, but the general alchemy puppets only have the cultivation level of building the gold elixir. Gold elixir and above are considered high-level puppets. The current alchemy puppets are at the Void Refining level at most.
In her previous life, Xie Lianxin successfully refined the puppets of the Mahayana period. She was thinking that if she designed a set of spiritual power circuits, did some tricks in it, and then promoted it and let people in the entire Immortal League use the puppets she created, wouldn't this be able to bury her own informants in the entire Immortal League?
She can spy on anyone she wants.
Feeling a little excited thinking about it, Xie Lianxin excitedly took out the painting pen and made a draft on the white paper.
